intro.cmn: 我是木琴，小槌敲敲木条，就会发出清脆的声音。
intro.yue: 我係木琴，小槌敲吓木條，就會發出清脆嘅聲音。

intro.en: I'm a tambourine. Shake my little jingles. Jingle, jingle!
intro.cmn: 我是铃鼓，摇一摇，小铃片叮当响！
intro.yue: 我係鈴鼓，搖一搖，小鈴片叮噹響！

intro.en: We're maracas. Little seeds rattle inside us. Shake slowly, then quickly!
intro.cmn: 我们是沙锤，小颗粒在里面沙沙响。慢慢摇，再快快摇！
intro.yue: 我哋係沙鎚，小粒粒喺入面沙沙響。慢慢搖，再快快搖！

intro.en: I'm the Star Ferry! My green and white boat carries people across Victoria Harbour.
intro.cmn: 我是天星小轮！我穿着绿白相间的外衣，载着大家穿过维多利亚港。
intro.yue: 我係天星小輪！我着住綠色同白色嘅外衣，載大家過維多利亞港。

intro.en: I'm a Ding Ding tram! I have two decks and travel along rails. Ding, ding!
intro.cmn: 我是叮叮车！我有上下两层，沿着铁轨慢慢走。叮叮！
intro.yue: 我係叮叮車！我有上下兩層，沿住路軌慢慢行。叮叮！

intro.en: I'm a double-decker bus! I have seats downstairs and upstairs. Let's explore Hong Kong!
intro.cmn: 我是双层巴士！楼下和楼上都有座位。一起看看香港吧！
intro.yue: 我係雙層巴士！樓下同樓上都有座位。一齊睇吓香港啦！

intro.en: I'm the Bank of China Tower! Look at my tall shape and big triangles. My windows can shine!
intro.cmn: 我是中银大厦！看看我高高的身体和大大的三角形。我的窗户会亮起来！
intro.yue: 我係中銀大廈！睇吓我高高嘅身同大大嘅三角形。我嘅窗會發光！

intro.en: I'm the Clock Tower in Tsim Sha Tsui! I'm made of red bricks and pale stone. Look up at my clock!
intro.cmn: 我是尖沙咀钟楼！我由红砖和浅色石头建成。抬头看看我的时钟吧！
intro.yue: 我係尖沙咀鐘樓！我用紅磚同淺色石頭砌成。抬頭睇吓我個鐘啦！

intro.en: Welcome to the dim sum shop! Little bamboo baskets hold buns and dumplings. Warm steam rises softly.
intro.cmn: 欢迎来到点心铺！小竹蒸笼里有包子和饺子。温暖的蒸汽轻轻飘起来。
intro.yue: 歡迎嚟到點心舖！小竹蒸籠入面有包同餃子。暖暖嘅蒸氣輕輕升起。

intro.en: I'm a beach umbrella. My shade makes a cool little spot on the sand.
intro.cmn: 我是遮阳伞，在沙滩上撑起一片凉凉的阴影。
intro.yue: 我係太陽傘，喺沙灘撐起一片涼涼嘅陰影。

intro.en: I'm a sand bucket. Fill me with sand, then tip me over to make a little tower.
intro.cmn: 我是沙桶，装满沙子，倒过来，就变成小塔啦！
intro.yue: 我係沙桶，裝滿沙，再倒轉，就變成小塔喇！

intro.en: I'm a shovel. Scoop, scoop! Let's dig a small hole in the sand.
intro.cmn: 我是铲子，铲呀铲，一起挖个小沙坑！
intro.yue: 我係鏟仔，鏟呀鏟，一齊挖個小沙坑！

intro.en: I'm a seashell. Look at my ridges. A little sea animal once lived inside.
intro.cmn: 我是贝壳，身上有一条条纹路。小海洋动物曾经住在里面。
intro.yue: 我係貝殼，身上有一條條紋路。小海洋動物曾經住喺入面。

intro.en: I'm a sandcastle. Stack the sandy towers and pat them gently. Ta-da!
intro.cmn: 我是沙堡，堆起小沙塔，轻轻拍一拍。完成啦！
intro.yue: 我係沙堡，堆起小沙塔，輕輕拍一拍。完成喇！

intro.en: I'm a little crab. My little legs help me scuttle sideways across the sand.
intro.cmn: 我是小螃蟹，小脚带着我横着走过沙滩。
intro.yue: 我係小蟹，小腳帶住我橫住行過沙灘。

intro.en: I'm a wave. I roll onto the shore, then slide back into the sea. Whoosh!
intro.cmn: 我是海浪，轻轻冲上岸，再退回海里。哗啦啦！
intro.yue: 我係海浪，輕輕湧上岸，再退返海入面。嘩啦啦！

intro.en: I'm the Sun, our bright star. My light helps warm the Earth.
intro.cmn: 我是太阳，是一颗明亮的恒星。我的阳光让地球暖暖的。
intro.yue: 我係太陽，係一粒明亮嘅恆星。我嘅陽光令地球暖笠笠。

intro.en: I'm Earth, our home. I have blue oceans and land, and I travel around the Sun.
intro.cmn: 我是地球，是我们的家。我的表面有海洋和陆地，我会绕着太阳转。
intro.yue: 我係地球，係我哋嘅家。我有海洋同陸地，會繞住太陽轉。

intro.en: I'm Mars, the red planet. I travel around the Sun too.
intro.cmn: 我是火星，红红的星球。我也会绕着太阳转。
intro.yue: 我係火星，紅紅嘅星球。我都會繞住太陽轉。

intro.en: I'm Jupiter, the biggest planet in our solar system. Look at my cloudy stripes!
intro.cmn: 我是木星，是太阳系里最大的行星。看，我的云层一条一条的！
intro.yue: 我係木星，係太陽系最大嘅行星。睇，我嘅雲層一條一條㗎！

intro.en: I'm Saturn. My beautiful rings are made of many little pieces of ice and rock.
intro.cmn: 我是土星。我的漂亮光环，是许多小小的冰块和石头组成的。
intro.yue: 我係土星。我嘅靚靚光環，係好多細細嘅冰塊同石頭組成㗎。

intro.en: We're stars, shining far away. The Sun is a star too.
intro.cmn: 我们是星星，在遥远的地方发光。太阳也是一颗恒星哦。
intro.yue: 我哋係星星，喺好遠嘅地方發光。太陽都係一粒恆星呀。

intro.en: I'm the Milky Way, a huge galaxy with so many stars. Our Sun belongs here too.
intro.cmn: 我是银河，有好多好多恒星。我们的太阳，也是银河里的一颗恒星。
intro.yue: 我係銀河，有好多好多恆星。我哋嘅太陽，都係銀河入面一粒恆星。

intro.en: I'm a satellite made by people. I travel around Earth and help us learn about our home.
intro.cmn: 我是人造卫星，是人们做出来的。我绕着地球转，帮大家认识我们的家。
intro.yue: 我係人造衛星，係人哋做出嚟嘅。我繞住地球轉，幫大家認識我哋嘅家。

intro.en: I'm sunshine. Let's enjoy a bright, sunny day.
intro.cmn: 我是阳光。今天晴朗又明亮，一起感受暖暖的太阳吧。
intro.yue: 我係陽光。今日晴朗又光猛，一齊感受暖笠笠嘅太陽啦。

intro.en: I'm a cloud. Lots of tiny water drops or ice crystals make me look fluffy.
intro.cmn: 我是云朵。好多小小的水滴或冰晶，让我看起来软绵绵的。
intro.yue: 我係雲朵。好多細細嘅水滴或者冰晶，令我睇落軟綿綿。

intro.en: We're raindrops, falling from a cloud. Pitter-patter on the ground!
intro.cmn: 我们是雨滴，从云里落下来。滴答滴答，落到地上啦！
intro.yue: 我哋係雨滴，喺雲入面跌落嚟。滴答滴答，落到地下啦！

intro.en: I'm wind, moving air. See the leaves drifting along with me!
intro.cmn: 我是风，是流动的空气。看，树叶跟着我飘起来啦！
intro.yue: 我係風，係流動嘅空氣。睇，樹葉跟住我飄起嚟啦！

intro.en: I'm a rainbow. Sunlight and raindrops make my beautiful colors.
intro.cmn: 我是彩虹。阳光遇到雨滴，就能出现我漂亮的颜色。
intro.yue: 我係彩虹。陽光遇到雨滴，就可以出現我靚靚嘅顏色。

intro.en: I'm an umbrella. Open me up to help keep the rain off you.
intro.cmn: 我是雨伞。把我打开，就能帮你挡住雨滴啦。
intro.yue: 我係雨傘。打開我，就可以幫你擋住雨滴啦。

intro.en: We're autumn leaves. Some trees turn red or golden before their leaves fall.
intro.cmn: 我们是秋天的树叶。有些树叶会变红、变黄，再轻轻飘落下来。
intro.yue: 我哋係秋天嘅樹葉。有啲樹葉會變紅、變黃，再輕輕飄落嚟。

intro.en: We're snowflakes, made of tiny ice crystals. We fall gently when it's cold enough.
intro.cmn: 我们是雪花，是小小的冰晶。天气足够冷时，我们会轻轻飘下来。
intro.yue: 我哋係雪花，係細細嘅冰晶。天氣夠凍嗰陣，我哋會輕輕飄落嚟。

intro.en: I'm milk. Pour me into a cup. A little sip!
intro.cmn: 我是牛奶。把我倒进杯子里，小口喝一喝！
intro.yue: 我係牛奶。倒我入杯仔度，飲一小啖啦！

intro.en: I'm bread. I have a golden crust and a soft middle.
intro.cmn: 我是面包。我的外皮金黄金黄，里面软软的。
intro.yue: 我係麵包。我嘅外皮金黃色，入面軟綿綿。

intro.en: We're eggs. Our shells are delicate. Carry us gently!
intro.cmn: 我们是鸡蛋。蛋壳容易碰破，轻轻地拿着我们吧！
intro.yue: 我哋係雞蛋。蛋殼好容易撞爛，輕輕拎住我哋啦！

intro.en: I'm yogurt. I'm cool and creamy. Use a little spoon!
intro.cmn: 我是酸奶。我凉凉的、滑滑的，用小勺子吃吧！
intro.yue: 我係乳酪。我涼涼哋、滑滑哋，用小匙羹食啦！

intro.en: I'm a tissue box. Take one soft tissue to wipe your hands.
intro.cmn: 我是纸巾盒。抽一张软软的纸巾，擦擦小手。
intro.yue: 我係紙巾盒。抽一張軟熟嘅紙巾，抹下小手啦。

intro.en: I'm a shopping cart. My wheels roll as we shop together!
intro.cmn: 我是购物车。轮子转呀转，我们一起逛超市！
intro.yue: 我係購物車。轆仔轉呀轉，我哋一齊行超市！

intro.en: I'm a shopping basket. Put our groceries inside. Let's count!
intro.cmn: 我是购物篮。把买的东西放进来，一起数一数！
intro.yue: 我係購物籃。將買嘅嘢放入嚟，一齊數下啦！

intro.en: I'm a camping lantern. Tap me and watch my warm light glow.
intro.yue: 我係露營燈。點一點，睇吓我暖暖嘅燈光。
intro.cmn: 我是露营灯。点一点，看看我暖暖的灯光。

intro.en: I'm a trail map. Follow my little path past the trees and the stream.
intro.yue: 我係行山地圖。沿住小路行，經過樹木同小溪。
intro.cmn: 我是徒步地图。沿着小路走，经过树木和小溪。

intro.en: I'm a pair of binoculars. Look through me to see the faraway mountains.
intro.yue: 我係望遠鏡。望入嚟，遠處嘅山都睇得清。
intro.cmn: 我是望远镜。看进来，远处的山也能看清。

intro.en: I'm a harp. My long strings make gentle, sparkling notes. Listen to my little tune!
intro.cmn: 我是竖琴，长长的琴弦弹出轻柔、明亮的声音。听听我的小曲吧！
intro.yue: 我係豎琴，長長嘅琴弦彈出輕柔、明亮嘅聲音。聽吓我嘅小曲啦！

intro.en: I'm a guitar. I have six strings. A little strum makes them ring together!
intro.cmn: 我是吉他，我有六根琴弦。轻轻拨一下，就能听到好听的声音！
intro.yue: 我係結他，我有六條琴弦。輕輕撥一下，就聽到好聽嘅聲音！

intro.en: I'm an imaginary alien friend. Wave hello! We can imagine a space adventure together.
intro.cmn: 我是想象中的外星朋友。挥挥手吧！一起想象一场太空冒险。
intro.yue: 我係想像中嘅外星朋友。揮揮手啦！一齊想像一場太空冒險。

intro.en: I'm an astronaut. My spacesuit helps me explore. Look at this little space rock!
intro.cmn: 我是宇航员，穿着宇航服来探索。看看这块小小的太空石头！
intro.yue: 我係太空人，着住太空衣嚟探索。睇吓呢粒細細嘅太空石仔！

intro.en: I'm a radio dish. I send messages across space. Hello, Earth!
intro.cmn: 我是通信天线，可以把消息送往太空远方。地球，你好呀！
intro.yue: 我係通訊天線，可以將訊息送去太空遠方。地球，你好呀！

fact.en: I climb trees and love to eat fruit.
fact.yue: 我會爬樹，仲鍾意食水果。
fact.cmn: 我会爬树，也爱吃水果。

intro.en: I'm a lemur. I climb trees and love to eat fruit. Look at my long tail!
intro.yue: 我係狐猴。我會爬樹，仲鍾意食水果。睇吓我條長尾巴！
intro.cmn: 我是狐猴。我会爬树，也爱吃水果。看看我的长尾巴！

fact.en: My colourful feathers open like a big fan.
fact.yue: 我啲靚靚尾羽可以打開，好似一把大扇咁。
fact.cmn: 我漂亮的尾羽可以展开，像一把大扇子。

intro.en: I'm a peacock. Look at my colourful feathers. They open like a big fan!
intro.yue: 我係孔雀。睇吓我啲靚靚尾羽，打開就好似一把大扇咁！
intro.cmn: 我是孔雀。看看我漂亮的尾羽，展开就像一把大扇子！

intro.en: I'm a goose. I have a long neck. My feet paddle under the water. Honk, honk!
intro.cmn: 我是鹅。我有长长的脖子，小脚在水下面划呀划。嘎嘎，嘎嘎！
intro.yue: 我係鵝。我有長長嘅頸，小腳喺水下面划呀划。嘎嘎，嘎嘎！

Representative phrases were selected based on lack of background interference, and are not continuous because phrases were often repeated. Shorter versions of phrases were chosen, and files were decimated to a sampling rate of 44100 Hz in order to comply with the journal's size limits for supporting information. Frequencies below 400 Hz were emphasized to compensate for the tag hardware's built-in high pass filter (see Methods text). In some cases, acoustic sonar pulses may be audible in the background of clips – this is due to the research vessel leaving echosounders on for safety in uncharted waters.

hummingbird.title: hummingbird-at-feeder.wav
hummingbird.author: andrew1280
hummingbird.description: Recorded 08/16/06 at 7:55 AM, at a hummingbird feeder, near the tiny town of Good Hart in Northern Michigan. I placed two Behringer measurement microphones with wind screens extremely close to a hummingbird feeder. You hear the beating of the birds wings and also its extremely quick chirping. I think these were Ruby Throated hummingbirds. My field guide said they don't live that far north, but they certainly didn't look anything like any other kind of hummingbird. I used a Marantz PDM660. No processing of any kind. Oh, yeah, there is a little thing called Lake Michigan in the background. A very peaceful day it was, I must say!
